name: Bluefin Fishing Barbados
summary: A small fishing charter run by Captain Rob Garrett from the Careenage in Bridgetown, on two 27 foot boats, Wicked Tuna and Fish On. Trips are private and limited to four anglers, aimed at families and young anglers, with hands-on help from the captain. Some trips add a swim with turtles and a snorkel over the Carlisle Bay wrecks.
standouts: Captain Rob Garrett has over 30 years of experience in Barbados waters
Private trips, limited to 4 people fishing
Hands-on instruction, especially for young anglers
States it is fully licensed and insured

contact.address: Worthing Beach, Christ Church; trips leave from the Careenage, Bridgetown

trips.title: 3-hour Fishing Special
trips.summary: A short private trip for families and individuals who want to be back early. It fishes close to the inshore reefs for barracuda, bonito and snapper.
highlights: Back in time for the rest of the day
trips.checkNotes: Booked by email (bluefinbarbados@gmail.com), the contact form, or phone and WhatsApp; the Contact and Book button opens an email. Price is for the private charter, not per person. Home page shows $350 USD; the trip page shows $350. Inclusions and group size not stated on this page.

trips.title: 4-Hour Fishing Charter
trips.summary: A private four hour trip from the Careenage, trolling with live bait or lures along the inner and outer reefs of the south and west coasts. Lines go in 10 to 15 minutes out, and you can mix in snorkelling over shipwrecks and swimming with turtles.
highlights: Fishing starts 10 to 15 minutes from the dock
Trolling with live bait or lures
Inner and outer reefs, south and west coasts
Can add snorkelling and a turtle swim
trips.requirements: Limited to 4 people on fishing charters
trips.checkNotes: Booked by email (bluefinbarbados@gmail.com), the contact form, or phone and WhatsApp; the Contact and Book button opens an email. Price is for the private charter, not per person.

trips.title: 5-hour Fish and Swim Special
trips.summary: An early start from Bridgetown for fishing along the west or south coast, aiming for wahoo, barracuda, mahi mahi and bonito. Afterwards the boat heads to Carlisle Bay for a swim with turtles and a snorkel over the wrecks. The operator recommends it for families with young anglers.
highlights: Swim with turtles and snorkel the Carlisle Bay wrecks
Good for families with young anglers
trips.requirements: Maximum 4 adults, or up to 6 if 3 are young anglers
trips.checkNotes: Booked by email (bluefinbarbados@gmail.com), the contact form, or phone and WhatsApp; the Contact and Book button opens an email. Price is for the private charter, not per person. Drinks are not mentioned on this trip page, unlike the other charters.
